title: NVIDIA and Palantir Bring Sovereign Intelligence to Critical Supply Chains
text: releases img src="https://iprsoftwaremedia.com/219/files/202609/38876c048ca50c779d310d7d819f27bd/6aa210be3d63325a96e97259_palantir-nvidia/palantir-nvidia_thmb.jpg?v=f0195c71-b6c0-4659-b603-2f73ebdc1de8" alt="Palantir and NVIDIA" align="left" hspace="15" vspace="5" / ![CDATA[ p strong News Summary: /strong span id="docs-internal-guid-72177864-7fff-cd18-b4be-785f711c2bbb" /span /p ul dir="ltr" li role="presentation" span id="docs-internal-guid-72177864-7fff-cd18-b4be-785f711c2bbb" span Collaboration establishes an AI stack combining Palantir sovereign AI and custom NVIDIA Nemotron open models for complex supply chain operations. /span /span /li li role="presentation" span id="docs-internal-guid-72177864-7fff-cd18-b4be-785f711c2bbb" span The AI stack is first being deployed within NVIDIA s supply chain to codify operational intelligence and accelerate the path from wafer to first token. /span /span /li li role="presentation" span id="docs-internal-guid-72177864-7fff-cd18-b4be-785f711c2bbb" span Organizations can optimize their own supply chains through the Palantir Sovereign AI Operating System Reference Architecture running on cloud or on-premises infrastructure. /span /span /li /ul p span id="docs-internal-guid-ae8720ec-7fff-ee80-68e8-59192940bdd3" /span /p p dir="ltr" span id="docs-internal-guid-ae8720ec-7fff-ee80-68e8-59192940bdd3" span Palantir Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ: PLTR) and NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced a collaboration to bring sovereign AI to critical supply chains, starting with /span a href="https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/from-wafer-out-to-first-token-codifying-supply-chain-expertise-with-nemotron-and-palantir-foundry/" span NVIDIA s own operations /span /a span . /span /span /p p dir="ltr" span id="docs-internal-guid-ae8720ec-7fff-ee80-68e8-59192940bdd3" span The deployment creates an AI stack that brings /span a href="https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai-data-science/foundation-models/nemotron/" span NVIDIA Nemotron /span /a span open models into Palantir Foundry and Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP), grounded in the Palantir Ontology, which aims to create unprecedented supply chain visibility, identify constraints, continuously codify operational expertise and guide decisions at machine speed — maintaining the reliability and efficiency of NVIDIA s AI infrastructure supply chain while retaining control and ownership of proprietary data. /span /span /p p dir="ltr" span id="docs-internal-guid-ae8720ec-7fff-ee80-68e8-59192940bdd3" span The AI stack powering this work and its applications across industries will be showcased in depth at /span a href="https://www.youtube.com/live/uijZR7hnDGM" span Palantir s AIPCon 11 conference /span /a span . Organizations across complex industries — including agriculture, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, retail, technology and governments — can use the AI stack to optimize their own unique supply chain operations. /span /span /p p dir="ltr" span id="docs-internal-guid-ae8720ec-7fff-ee80-68e8-59192940bdd3" span NVIDIA operates one of the most complex supply chains, spanning millions of parts, thousands of suppliers and a global network of manufacturing partners. Bringing a rack-scale AI system to production requires the coordinated availability of compute, memory, networking, power, cooling and mechanical components. As demand for AI infrastructure accelerates, NVIDIA works closely with its ecosystem to secure supply for the 1.3 million parts in each /span a href="https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/technologies/rubin/" span NVIDIA Vera Rubin /span /a span rack and scale AI infrastructure faster. /span /span /p p dir="ltr" span id="docs-internal-guid-ae8720ec-7fff-ee80-68e8-59192940bdd3" span NVIDIA has arguably the most valuable, intricate and complex supply chain in the world. Our sovereign stack, powered by Nemotron models and Ontology, is delivering capabilities that exceed the frontier while providing alpha protection qualities unavailable otherwise, said Alex Kar

title: Trump Dividend: America Is Winning — and Americans Should Win With It
text: News Search Select Category All News Briefings & Statements All Presidential Actions Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research All Briefings & Statements Presidential Actions All Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research Last night, President Donald J. Trump unveiled the Trump Dividend — a historic $5,000 cash payment to every adult American citizen, made possible by the strength of the American economy under his leadership. The announcement is the latest proof that President Trump does what the so-called “experts” say cannot be done: he delivers for the American people. “Because we’ve done so well, and because our country is making so much money, only I can make this promise to you, and here is my promise: if the Republicans win the House of Representatives and the United States Senate… I will issue a dividend to every adult citizen in the United States of America for $5,000.” — President Donald J. Trump ( Watch ) America is winning again — and the American people should share in that success. Like a successful company returning cash to its shareholders, the Trump Dividend is possible only because of President Trump. In his second term, he has unleashed trillions in new private investment, launched an unprecedented crackdown on government waste, and rebuilt American strength at home. That success belongs to the American people — and the Trump Dividend returns it to them. President Trump delivers results no one else will even attempt. He captured Venezuelan dictator Nicolás Maduro and secured a landmark oil deal in its wake, delivered historic tax relief, and put American workers first with an America First trade policy . The same leadership that shattered the old limits of what Washington thought possible is now prepared to put $5,000 directly into Americans’ pockets. President Trump’s priority is making Americans richer. The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act and the Working Families Tax Cuts produced bigger paychecks, bigger refunds, and more money left with the workers who earned it. The Trump Dividend is the next chapter of that fight —not another Washington program or lecture from the “experts,” but cash in the hands of American citizens. This happens only with President Trump and a Republican Congress. Democrats will not deliver a dividend, they will deliver the opposite — higher taxes, open borders, and the same failed communist agenda that makes American families poorer and punishes the people who work the hardest. The Trump Dividend depends on President Trump and Republicans. Democrat control means America loses — and working people pay the price. title: President Trump Delivers Historic Results for the American People in Under Two Years
text: News Search Select Category All News Briefings & Statements All Presidential Actions Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research All Briefings & Statements Presidential Actions All Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research In less than two years, President Donald J. Trump has driven the most consequential stretch of governing in modern American history. He inherited a disaster — and turned it into a historic comeback. President Trump sealed the border, drove violent crime to historic lows, unleashed American energy, cut taxes for working families, focused Washington on merit and common sense, and deployed American strength on the global stage. Promises made. Promises kept. Results delivered. Securing America’s Borders and Putting Americans First President Trump ended Democrats’ open borders disaster, established the strongest border in history, and restored American sovereignty. The Trump Administration immediately ended “catch-and-release” — and has not released a single illegal alien into the country for 15 straight months . The U.S. recorded negative net migration in 2025 for the first time in at least half a century. More than three million migrants have left the country in President Trump’s second term — the largest reduction in illegal immigration in modern history — with the illegal alien population down by at least 2.3 million. Under President Trump, asylum is now granted in just 7% of cases — a historic low — plummeting from over 50% rubber-stamped under Biden. The Trump Administration has stopped more than 10,000 narcoterrorists from entering the country. ICE has arrested more than 10,000 illegal alien gang members. President Trump designated major foreign cartels as terrorist organizations, including Tren de Aragua, MS-13, and Clan del Golfo. President Trump signed the Laken Riley Act , HALT Fentanyl Act , and Secure America Act into law — mandating detention of violent illegal alien criminals, permanently classifying fentanyl-related substances as Schedule I drugs, and delivering the largest border enforcement investment in a generation. Fentanyl trafficking at the southern border collapsed 56% and fentanyl-linked deaths plunged 22% in a single year. The Trump Administration cut illegals off taxpayer benefits, revoked more than 175,000 visas from foreign nationals, carried out the largest denaturalization effort in history, and launched a nationwide crackdown on illegal alien CDL fraud to get unvetted drivers off America’s roads. Making Communities Safe Again President Trump ended Democrats’ sick war on law enforcement and restored the simple idea that violent criminals belong behind bars. The U.S. murder rate fell to a historic low in 2025 — the lowest level in 125 years — after the largest annual drop in violent crime in American history. Preliminary data show the collapse continuing in the first half of 2026, with violent crime down another 10%, murders down another 23%, and rapes down another 18.6% over the same period last year. The Trump Administration has captured nine of the FBI’s Ten Most Wanted fugitives — more than twice as many as the entire previous four-year Administration — and five of the FBI’s Most Wanted Fraudsters. President Trump’s campaign to make Washington, D.C. safe and beautiful again has produced more than 17,000 arrests , cut homicides by more than 50% from Biden-era levels, and restored dozens of neglected fountains, statues, and monuments. Rebuilding an Economy for Working Americans President Trump engineered a blue-collar boom with lower taxes, more factories, trillions in new investment, and fair trade that puts American workers first again. title: President Trump Honors 9/11 Heroes and Renews America’s Vow to Never Forget
text: News Search Select Category All News Briefings & Statements All Presidential Actions Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research All Briefings & Statements Presidential Actions All Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research Today, President Donald J. Trump stood with first responders, Gold Star families, and the Tunnel to Towers Foundation to honor the Americans who ran toward the fire on September 11, 2001. At his side was a 21-foot steel beam recovered from the wreckage of the South Tower — carried more than 10,500 miles on Tunnel to Towers’ Steel Across America tour as a living reminder of the courage that rose from the ruins and our duty to Never Forget. President Trump posthumously awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom to Welles Crowther, the 24-year-old equities trader remembered as the “Man in the Red Bandana”: “After the plane hit the South Tower, a group of people on the 78th floor were trapped with broken bones, charred skin and eyes, and lungs filled with black smoke. Death was all about them; it was certain. They were sure they were going to die. Then suddenly, a rescuer appeared. They call him the ‘Man in the Red Bandana.’” ( Watch ) Welles’s mother, Alison, and sister, Paige, accepted the Medal on his behalf: “This means the world to me, my daughters, Paige and Honor, and our entire family. This will be treasured for generations to come.” ( Watch ) President Trump announced that the U.S. Coast Guard will commission a new Fast Response Cutter in memory of FDNY firefighter and Coast Guard reservist Jeffrey Palazzo — one of the 343 firefighters killed on 9/11: “Before September 11, he had already saved many lives… Him and the other members of Rescue Squad 5 died at the World Trade Center while fighting to rescue fellow New Yorkers.” ( Watch ) “On 9/11, nearly 3,000 precious souls were stolen from us — killed by evil terrorists at the World Trade Center, the Pentagon, and on Flight 93. All of these years later, we gather on another Tuesday morning in September to reaffirm the sacred vow we made a quarter of a century ago: we will never forget.” ( Watch ) “In just over 100 minutes, 175,000 tons of steel and concrete were reduced to ruin and 3,000 lives were extinguished… This battered piece of steel here today on the Ellipse is a reminder that America is blessed with a strength no fire can consume, no evil can conquer, and no terror can destroy.” ( Watch ) “The 16,000-pound beam lifted from the wreckage of the South Tower will forever testify to the courage and resilience and spirit of a city and a nation that saw our homeland struck, our towers knocked down and stood back up stronger, more determined, and more united than ever before… When we see the steel, we’re reminded that no matter what threat or challenge comes our way, America will fight, America will endure, and America will prevail.” ( Watch ) “For the past few months, Tunnel to Towers has taken this steel across the nation to remind Americans of what we overcame that day and what our heroes did… On September 11, 23 members of the New York Police Department, 37 members of the Port Authority Police, three Court officers, and 343 members of the New York Fire Department made the ultimate sacrifice.” ( Watch ) On Friday, the 25th anniversary of September 11, 2001, President Trump and Vice President JD Vance will visit the sites of the attacks to join the nation in remembering the heroes of that day and honoring the families who still bear that loss.
